The packing is the n = 172 arrangement of jlevy/squares#935 (T-282, Evan Daniel's packing improved by Doğa Özden) at its exact local optimum, as the issue states; the issue credits the arrangement to Daniel and Özden.
claims: n172/n172_witness.yaml states 172 unit squares, centre and basis (cos, sin) as exact rationals, in a square of exact rational side, which #946 prints cut as 13.61468985328358057514628890087947061618972730200175769881... and the root README rounds up at 12 places as 13.614689853284. Like n199_witness.yaml it follows this repository's Witness/v2 witness object without the schema's envelope (no softschema block, no claim, a notes field, an id with capitals). n172/n172_exact.json states the same packing as [center_x, center_y, cos, sin] rows, with the side and the coefficients of a quintic; n172/n172_optimum_300_digits.txt states the side, centres and edge directions at the local optimum truncated to 300 decimals, the squares that can move without changing the side at their certificate positions.

The issue and README say the side is 1.6e-319 above the real root near 13.6147 of the irreducible 62x^5 - 4116x^4 + 107933x^3 - 1397031x^2 + 8918035x - 22427977, the exact local optimum of the registered arrangement: a solution of the contact equations at about 390 digits closes all contacts with a residual below 1e-389, the contact equations have rank 285 and fix the side to first order, non-negative contact forces in balance exist (floating point), and the polynomial was identified from 108 digits of an earlier 130-digit solution and agrees with the 390-digit side to 386 digits. Local optimality has no formal proof and no symbolic derivation exists, as the issue says. It is the 172-square core of #939's packing; no square was added, removed or moved to another place in the contact structure. The issue calls it the same type of result as T-098 and says it understands that such results await the RV-3 ruling.

verify_exact.py (Python standard library, fractions.Fraction) checks exact unit directions, containment, a separating-axis test on every pair with centres closer than sqrt(2), and by an exact sign test that the side lies within 1e-318 above a root of the quintic; the issue says it is the one checker, written for this certificate, not run against this repository's checkers. The issue says the local optimization, high-precision solution, rational certificate, checking and figure were produced with Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic) under Joost de Winter's direction. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
